title: 13 Works By Finnish Architects Alvar, Aino, and Elissa Aalto Added to UNESCO’s World Heritage List
summary: At the 48th session of UNESCO’s World Heritage Committee in Busan, South Korea, 13 works by Finnish modernist architects Aino, Elissa, and Alvar Aalto were added to the organization’s World Heritage List.
